title: Prolapse
summary: PROLAPSE, noun prolaps'. [Latin prolapsus, prolabor.] A falling down or falling out of some part of the body, as of the uterus or intestines. PROLAPSE, verb intransitive prolaps'. To fall down or out;

inlines.v: PROLAPSE, noun prolaps'. [Latin prolapsus, prolabor.] A falling down or falling out of some part of the body, as of the uterus or intestines. PROLAPSE, verb intransitive prolaps'. To fall down or out; to project too much.
